Heavy Division Sign Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Heavy Division Sign because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2797, which you can use as ➗ in HTML, \2797 in CSS, or type with Alt+10135 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Heavy Division Sign is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2797 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Heavy Division Sign has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ➗ or the hex escape ➗.

How to type heavy division sign on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 0 1 3 5 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 10135.
  4. Release Alt. The Heavy Division Sign character (➗) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type heavy division sign on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Heavy Division Sign. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Heavy Division Sign" and click the character to insert it.

How to use heavy division sign in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2797"; ()
  • Python: \u2797 or chr(0x2797)
  • JavaScript: \u2797 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2797)
  • JSON: "\u2797"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ➗?

No legacy Alt code exists for Heavy Division Sign because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2797 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ➗ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ➗, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+10135 not work?

Alt+10135 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Heavy Division Sign?

The Unicode codepoint for Heavy Division Sign is U+2797. You can use this value in HTML as ➗, in CSS as \2797, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ➗ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2797, then click it.
